title: Balboa 58083 M7 Heater Element

specifications.dimensions_or_sizes: Standard 15-inch or 2-inch dual sensor M7 heater assembly housing element
part_numbers_or_compatibility: Master Spas and other compatible hot tub brands using Balboa control systems

summary: The Balboa 58083 is a 5.5kW 230V replacement heater element designed for Balboa M7 spa control systems. It utilizes dual M7 sensors to accurately monitor water temperature and flow without traditional pressure switches.
